job: retain a complete bounded recovery artifact before collecting immutable log history
artifact: SnapshotArtifact v2 through RetentionStore and FdbServiceStore
initial_state: isolated FDB scope with two accepted document changes and no baseline
expectation: the floor advances only after a verified artifact covers every collected position
perturbation: attempt collection with no baseline, a corrupt descriptor, and a baseline behind the requested prefix
observations: missing baseline refuses collection without moving the frontier or floor
corrupt descriptor returns typed corruption and publishes no pointer
baseline through one cannot authorize pruning through two
baseline through two seals atomically and permits pruning through two
a page starting before the new floor returns BehindFloor
invariant: pruning through N requires a validated immutable state-bearing artifact covering every document and tombstone through N
limitations: this layer establishes the server prune gate but does not provide paged HTTP artifact recovery
atomic client installation of the recovered artifact and checkpoint remains the next stack layer
